intro_zh: 北京是中国的首都，有三千余年建城史、八百余年建都史。这座古都既有故宫、长城的恢宏，也有胡同、四合院的市井烟火。
intro_en: Beijing, the capital of China, has over 3,000 years of history as a city and 800 as a capital. The ancient city holds both the grandeur of the Forbidden City and Great Wall and the everyday life of its hutongs.
culture_zh: 红墙黄瓦的皇城气派与胡同里的「京味儿」生活并存，京剧、相声、四合院与冰糖葫芦，处处是老北京的文化记忆。
culture_en: Imperial grandeur of red walls and golden tiles coexists with hutong life; Peking opera, crosstalk, courtyard homes and candied haws are all memories of old Beijing.

attractions.desc_zh: 明清两代皇宫，世界最大的古代宫殿建筑群。
attractions.desc_en: Imperial palace of the Ming and Qing—the world's largest ancient palace complex.

attractions.desc_zh: 八达岭一段最为著名，万里长城蜿蜒于群山。
attractions.desc_en: The Badaling section is the most famous, as the wall winds across the mountains.

attractions.desc_zh: 明清皇帝祭天之所，祈年殿庄严优美。
attractions.desc_en: Where Ming and Qing emperors prayed to Heaven; the Hall of Prayer is solemn and elegant.
attractions.img: 北京 天坛 祈年殿

attractions.desc_zh: 皇家园林典范，昆明湖与万寿山相映。
attractions.desc_en: A masterpiece of imperial gardens, with Kunming Lake set off by Longevity Hill.

foods.desc_zh: 皮酥肉嫩，卷饼蘸酱，京城名菜之首。
foods.desc_en: Crisp skin and tender meat wrapped in pancakes—Beijing's foremost dish.

foods.desc_zh: 黄酱炒肉丁配菜码的老北京面。
foods.desc_en: Old-Beijing noodles with fried soybean-paste pork and crisp vegetables.

foods.desc_zh: 老北京独特的发酵豆汁配炸焦圈。
foods.desc_en: A uniquely old-Beijing fermented mung-bean drink with fried dough rings.
